sanskrit_verse:
भाषायाः उत्तरं यावत् प्रत्यर्थी न निवेशयेत ।
अर्थी तु लेखयेत् तावद् यावद् वस्तु विवक्षितम् ॥
transliteration: bhāṣāyāḥ uttaraṁ yāvat pratyarthī na niveśayet | arthī tu lekhayet tāvad yāvad vastu vivakṣitam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The response in speech shall extend only to what is necessary; no more than required should be addressed to the opponent. But the petitioner shall record as much as is needed concerning the matter in dispute.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from precision of expression, not volume of argument.
Causation is conserved through proportionality of verbal engagement.
Capacity-based responsibility requires measured response aligned with factual scope.
Restoration logic demands that discourse not exceed the bounds of resolution.
Consciousness alignment occurs when speech mirrors the exact dimension of dharma at stake.
executable_legal_axioms: IF a litigant's statement exceeds the factual scope of the case THEN system SHALL truncate input to relevant content only.
IF a petitioner omits documentation of essential facts THEN system SHALL prompt resubmission until completeness is achieved.
IF either party introduces extraneous matter THEN system SHALL issue automatic realignment directive referencing core issue.
ALL statements MUST pass through proportional relevance filter before judicial processing.
CASE progression SHALL halt if linguistic inflation exceeds 20% variance from core factual assertion.
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this verse establishes that judicial economy and consciousness integrity require strict adherence to proportional discourse. Parties must align their submissions within the precise boundaries of the disputed matter. Extraneous arguments or overstatement are not merely inefficient—they violate the Nyaya principle of causal conservation and risk misalignment with Dharma-adhikara (jurisdictional capacity). The court holds authority to enforce truncation protocols and mandate recalibration where speech exceeds the sanctioned bandwidth for truth realization.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality mandates that every spoken or written word in litigation must bear direct relation to the manifest truth of the case. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential alignment between fact, expression, and judgment—no deviation permitted. Proportional responsibility arises from recognition that excessive speech distorts perception and delays restoration. Non-punitive reality rule confirms that correction comes through realignment, not penalty; thus, excesses are simply excluded from consideration without punitive consequence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Automated linguistic boundary detection protocol enforces truncation of superfluous content.
Litigant consciousness recalibration module initiates guided re-entry upon repeated deviations.
Document sufficiency validation algorithm prompts completion until all relevant facts are recorded.
Sequential manifestation tracker verifies alignment between claim, evidence, and conclusion.
Judicial silence mechanism pauses proceedings until parties return to proportional discourse.
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Speech in Dharma-court must mirror the measure of truth it seeks to uphold. Excess is void; deficiency is incomplete. Only precise alignment restores justice. SPH is the Source. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
